name: Local Grove | 1g Live Rosin | Juicee J + Rainbow Guava
description:
Genetics: Cap Junky x (Gelato 41 x Sunset Sherbert BX) + Rainbow Belts x Strawguava

BADDER BLEND: Badder Blend Rosin is crafted by combining water hash from two complementary strains and pressing them together to create a single, unified solventless expression. This process allows terpene profiles to merge during extraction and curing, resulting in a smooth, whipped badder with layered flavor, enhanced depth, and balanced potency. The final product delivers a unique terpene experience that highlights the best characteristics of each strain while maintaining the clean, refined texture and quality Local Grove is known for.
